ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web diagram, water flea (water flea) is located at the lower left, and southern pygmy perch is located above it and slightly to the left. In the diagram there is an arrow from water flea pointing to southern pygmy perch, indicating that water flea is one of the food sources of this perch. Reasoning: The arrows in the food web indicate energy flowing from the organism being eaten to the predator. If all water fleas are removed, southern pygmy perch will lose one food source, so their number will decrease.
